COALESCE simplification breaks when removing constant detection loop

#### Description

The COALESCE simplification function is throwing a `NameError` because it's trying to use an undefined variable `arg_index`. This happens when the function attempts to simplify COALESCE expressions but the loop that was supposed to find the first constant argument and set `arg_index` has been removed.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
import sqlglot
from sqlglot import optimizer

# This will trigger the error during optimization
sql = "SELECT COALESCE(NULL, 'test', 'fallback') FROM table1"
parsed = sqlglot.parse_one(sql)
optimized = optimizer.optimize(parsed)
```

The error occurs when the simplify_coalesce function tries to access `arg_index` without it being defined, since the loop that was meant to find the first constant argument index was removed but the code still references this variable.
</issue>
